raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Physical aspect ratio Lx/Ly",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The schematic suggests approximately 3:1, but no numerical side lengths or coordinate formulas establish the physical aspect ratio. Hexagonal element counts need not equal physical length ratios.",
      "readings": [
        "Lx/Ly = 3, following the schematic and the 60:20 count ratio.",
        "Lx/Ly approximately 3.4, converting the counts using regular hexagonal cell spacing."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Fig. 1(a) labels only Lx and Ly; Sec. 3.4 gives HNex × HNey = 60 × 20 for the first mesh; Sec. 3.1 references coordinate-generation code without supplying its formulas."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Downward point-load magnitude F",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The load is identified symbolically, without a numerical magnitude or normalization.",
      "readings": [
        "F = 1 in consistent force units.",
        "F = 1000 in the same force units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Fig. 1(a) shows a downward arrow labelled F; Sec. 2 introduces the external load without specifying its magnitude."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Solid Young's modulus E0",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The stiffness contrast is specified, but the solid modulus is not. The unit modulus used to define k0 does not explicitly set E0.",
      "readings": [
        "E0 = 1, with Emin = 10^-9.",
        "E0 = 210000 in consistent stress units, with Emin = 0.00021."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Sec. 2, Eq. (1), specifies Emin/E0 = 10^-9 and defines k0 at unit modulus; Sec. 3.2 mentions E0 and Emin without numerical values."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No Poisson's ratio is supplied for the isotropic plane-stress constitutive law.",
      "readings": [
        "Poisson's ratio = 0.30.",
        "Poisson's ratio = 0.33."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 3.2 specifies plane-stress assumptions for KE; neither that section nor Sec. 2 supplies Poisson's ratio."
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The plane-stress model does not state a thickness or explicitly define compliance per unit thickness.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform thickness t = 1 in consistent length units.",
        "Uniform thickness t = 0.1 in the same length units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Sec. 3.2 specifies plane stress without thickness; Sec. 2 assumes normalized element volumes vj = 1 without identifying a physical thickness."
    }
  ]
}
